Vendored third-party libraries in this folder — self-hosted so the site
doesn't depend on cdnjs/unpkg, and so the same files can be pulled
straight into the "Download Offline POS" package. Unmodified from their
published npm packages.

xlsx.full.min.js
  Package : xlsx (SheetJS)
  Version : 0.18.5
  License : Apache-2.0
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/xlsx
  Used by : app.html, offline/app.html (Excel export)

jszip.min.js
  Package : jszip
  Version : 3.10.1
  License : MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/jszip
  Used by : app.html only, to assemble the "Download Offline POS" .zip
            client-side. Not included in the offline package itself —
            the offline copy never needs to zip anything.

jsbarcode.min.js
  Package : jsbarcode
  Version : 3.12.3
  License : MIT
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsbarcode
  Used by : barcode-generator.html only (barcode rendering).

qrcode.js
qrcode_UTF8.js
  Package : qrcode-generator
  Version : 2.0.4
  License : MIT
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator
  Used by : barcode-generator.html only (QR code rendering). qrcode_UTF8.js is the
            package's own optional UTF-8 string-encoding patch and must
            load after qrcode.js.

supabase.min.js
  Package : @supabase/supabase-js
  Version : 2.112.4
  License : MIT
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/@supabase/supabase-js
  Used by : app.html only (Account & Subscription, Settings → Premium —
            sign in with Google and redeem a code to unlock Premium).
            The prebuilt dist/umd/supabase.js from the published package,
            unmodified. Wrapped in its own OFFLINE-STRIP marker in app.html
            and never fetched into the "Download Offline POS" package —
            sign-in needs a network connection, which the offline copy
            deliberately has none of.
